description: Square ditched enclosure, containing a well and a pit. The well provided a series of structured deposits, which made up almost all the material from this site. Dated based on ceramics to the later 2nd - early 3rd CE, and the well appears to have filled in in the early 4th CE. Religious/ritual interpretation suggested in lieu of any other evidence, RSRB marks it as a 'shrine'.
